content.description: P1 it01: base values kept; early_start switched on to the M2 moto target, sidewalk seeking switched on for moto_seeker to the M10a/F2 sidewalk target.

driver_archetypes.rationale: Kept at Saval et al. 2023 Table 11 (car): the prompt has no simulated-vs-observed feedback yet, so nothing shows M1/car (0.3467 s) or M6 car times are off; cars stop at red (M3/share/car 0.0041).
Kept: no rule applies to custom2 on this net (no option for it), so it must ride like car_saval and not shift M1/car or M6 car times.
Kept at Saval et al. 2023 Table 11 (motorcycle); without feedback on M1/moto (0.2957 s), M4 overshoot (0.62) or M5 queue length (15.8 m), I do not change car-following or lateral gap in a first step.

Kept: same riders as moto_saval except they may take the sidewalk (M10a 0.56 veh/cycle, F2 sidewalk share 0.049 at q20-40 m); share 0.1 with p_sidewalk 0.4 gives about 0.04 of motorcycles, near that observed share.
Kept at the SUMO default jmTimegapMinor = 1.0 s: no feedback yet on M7a (5.59 waiters), M7b (5.46 s) or M7c (0.29 s/veh), so there is no evidence for moving the early-leaving lever.

traci_rules.rationale: Kept at Saval's 0.5 for front-row motorcycles: M3/share/moto is 0.098 of all motorcycles and M3/per_cycle 3.9 veh, but without the simulated front-row fraction I cannot tell whether 0.5 over- or under-shoots, so I leave it for the next iteration's feedback.

M2/early/moto observed 0.1302 share in the last 10 s of red, and the rule is off at p = 0, so M2/early/moto is 0 in the base; p = 0.13 sets the per-front-row-vehicle probability to the observed share, t_before_green = 7 s lies inside the observed 4-10 s lead time, v_max = 2 m/s keeps the creep slow.

M10a observes 0.56 sidewalk riders per cycle and F2/p/sidewalk is 0.049 at q20-40 m (0.009 at q0-20 m), so the draw starts at q = 20 m and p_sidewalk = 0.4 of the 10% seekers gives about 0.04 overall; p_wrong_lane and p_right_lane stay 0 because they are inapplicable on this net and would be redistributed onto the sidewalk.

reasoning: No simulated feedback is in the prompt, so I kept the Saval car-following and lateral values and the red-running probability, and changed only the two behaviours that are switched off in the base while the observation targets give a number. early_start p = 0.13 matches M2/early/moto (0.1302) with t_before_green = 7 s inside the 4-10 s target lead time. Sidewalk seeking is set with q = 20 m and p_sidewalk = 0.4 on a 0.1 seeker share (about 0.04 overall) to approach F2/p/sidewalk 0.049 at q20-40 m and M10a 0.56 veh/cycle. p_wrong_lane and p_right_lane stay 0 since the prompt says they are inapplicable here and are redistributed onto the sidewalk.
